announcement.SChinese:
✨ 1.1.2 更新啦！

液态玻璃
• 新增可选的液态玻璃主题，颜色会跟随当前主题变化
• Android 13 以下版本不会显示液态玻璃开关
• 设置中可以调节折射率和透明度
• 整合包页的添加按钮、市场和整合包详情的回到顶部按钮现在会折射底下的内容
• 横屏模式使用侧边玻璃导航，主页面改为上下切换

整合包
• 应用整合包时会带上 core 中多出来的依赖（例如 Newtonsoft.Json.dll），不会替换启动器自带的 BepInEx 程序集
• 导入或安装时如果名称已存在，会询问是否覆盖
• 新建同名整合包时会提示已存在，不会直接创建
• 从其他整合包导入模组时支持搜索，选中条保持稳定
• 分类标题旁现在会显示该分类的模组数量
• 文件浏览中，modpack.json 的锁定、编辑和删除图标现在对齐，编辑和删除按钮更加靠近

模组市场
• 模组现在可以拥有多个版本
• 下载页面会列出每个版本的直链和网盘地址
• 当前版本会用于主安装按钮
• 版本说明现在支持 Markdown 显示
• 列表、分类和标签缓存超过 30 分钟后会自动重新拉取
• 请求失败时仍会保留并显示旧的缓存数据

日志与公告
• 公告和更新说明现在支持 Markdown
• 保留原有换行，裸链接可以直接点击，图片也可以正常显示
• 整合包日志改用与代码编辑器相同的视图
• 日志级别会自动着色，支持按源行换行，并默认显示行号

游戏运行
• 已安装的游戏版本发生变化后，会重新复制游戏数据，避免新游戏使用旧的 global-metadata.dat
• 游戏内 Toast 现在改由启动器上下文显示
• 设置中新增关闭分层编译的选项，用于规避 Android 16 上大型整合包触发的 libclrjit 崩溃
• 默认开启分层编译，避免模组内容无法正常显示

🎮 祝大家游玩愉快！
✨ 感谢大家一直以来的支持！
announcement.English:
✨ Version 1.1.2 is here!

Liquid Glass
• Added an optional Liquid Glass theme, with colors that follow the current theme
• The Liquid Glass option is hidden on Android versions below Android 13
• Added settings for adjusting refraction and transparency
• The add button on the modpack page, along with the back-to-top buttons in the Mod Market and modpack details, now refract the content underneath
• Landscape mode now uses side glass navigation, with the main pages switched vertically

Modpacks
• Applying a modpack now includes additional dependencies from core, such as Newtonsoft.Json.dll, without replacing the BepInEx assemblies bundled with the launcher
• Importing or installing an item with an existing name now asks for confirmation before overwriting it
• Creating a modpack with an existing name now shows a warning instead of creating it directly
• Added search when importing mods from another modpack, while keeping the selection bar stable
• Category headers now display the number of mods in each category
• In the file browser, the lock, edit, and delete icons for modpack.json are now aligned, with the edit and delete buttons placed closer together

Mod Market
• Mods can now have multiple versions
• The download page lists direct download and cloud-drive links for each version
• The current version is used for the main install button
• Version descriptions now support Markdown
• Lists, categories, and tags are automatically refreshed when their cache is older than 30 minutes
• If a request fails, the previous cached data remains visible

Logs & Announcements
• Announcements and update notes now support Markdown
• Line breaks are preserved, plain URLs are clickable, and images can be displayed
• Modpack logs now use the same view as the code editor
• Log levels are color-coded, source lines are wrapped, and line numbers are shown by default

Game Runtime
• When the installed game version changes, the launcher now recopies the game data to prevent a new game version from using an outdated global-metadata.dat
• In-game Toast messages are now displayed through the launcher context
• Added an option to disable tiered compilation in Settings to work around libclrjit crashes caused by large modpacks on Android 16
• Tiered compilation is enabled by default to prevent mod content from failing to appear

🎮 Have fun playing!
✨ Thank you for your continued support!
